get_fast_rcnn_blob_names: get the list of blob names needed for Fast R-CNN training or inference depending on the is_training flag
add_fast_rcnn_blobs: add Fast R-CNN training blobs to a minibatch by sampling RoIs from each image in the roidb
sample_rois: sample foreground and background RoIs from a single image entry and return a blob dictionary with labels and targets
expand_bbox_targets: expand compact bounding-box regression targets into the 4-of-4K representation used by the network for loss computation
add_multilevel_rois: distribute training RoIs across different FPN levels for models configured with multi-level RoI support
